REQ-005.design_rationale: Section 2.1 defines NoteNotationHelper.kt (NoteHeadType enum WHOLE/HALF/QUARTER/EIGHTH, getNoteHeadType, isDotted, isSharp) and specifies Compose Canvas rendering on StaffCanvas.kt and WrappedStaffCanvas.kt for hollow ovals, stems, eighth-note flags, augmentation dots, and sharp glyphs.
REQ-005.tasks_rationale: Task 1 defines falsifiable unit tests in NoteNotationHelperTest.kt and implementation steps across NoteNotationHelper.kt, StaffCanvas.kt, and WrappedStaffCanvas.kt, verified in Task 5.
REQ-005.debate_rationale: ADR-005 evaluates horizontal glyph spacing trade-offs (-18.dp sharp offset, +13.dp dot offset) and rejects heavyweight external MusicXML/SMuFL WebView rendering engines (Verovio) to preserve Compose reactivity and APK size without arbitrary source-file line caps.
REQ-005.evidence_rationale: verification.md Sections 2-4 confirm NoteNotationHelperTest (testNoteHeadTypeMapping, testIsDotted, testIsSharp) and assembleDebug passed with exit code 0.

REQ-006.design_rationale: Section 2.2 updates PracticeState with tempoMultiplier (default 1.0f) and effectiveBpm ((song.defaultBpm * tempoMultiplier).toInt().coerceAtLeast(20)), adds PracticeEngine.setTempoMultiplier, and wires speed selection in PracticeScreen and SettingsDialog.
REQ-006.tasks_rationale: Task 2 and Task 4 specify unit tests in PracticeEngineTest.kt for setTempoMultiplier and effectiveBpm and implementation in PracticeEngine.kt, PracticeViewModel.kt, PracticeScreen.kt, and SettingsDialog.kt.
REQ-006.debate_rationale: ADR-006 evaluates mid-playback speed transitions at note boundaries via dynamic StateFlow reads and rejects mutating Song.defaultBpm in place to preserve domain model immutability.
REQ-006.evidence_rationale: verification.md Sections 2-4 confirm PracticeEngineTest (testTempoMultiplierAndEffectiveBpm, testResetPreservesTempoAndLoop) and assembleDebug passed with exit code 0.

REQ-007.design_rationale: Section 2.2 adds loopStartIndex, loopEndIndex, and isLoopActive to PracticeState, defines setLoopRange, onNoteTappedForLoop, and clearLoop in PracticeEngine, implements loop wrap-around in evaluateMidi and onBeatTimeout, and adds visual brackets and tap gestures to StaffCanvas and WrappedStaffCanvas.
REQ-007.tasks_rationale: Task 2 specifies unit tests in PracticeEngineTest.kt for setLoopRange, onNoteTappedForLoop, clearLoop, and loop wrap-around, and implementation across PracticeEngine.kt, PracticeViewModel.kt, StaffCanvas.kt, and WrappedStaffCanvas.kt.
REQ-007.debate_rationale: ADR-007 documents non-destructive loop index state management and intentional continuous drilling until loop clearance, rejecting sub-list slicing of Song.notes to preserve measure barline alignment and surrounding score context.
REQ-007.evidence_rationale: verification.md Sections 2-4 confirm PracticeEngineTest (testLoopRangeAndNavigation, testOnNoteTappedForLoop, testResetPreservesTempoAndLoop) and assembleDebug passed with exit code 0.

REQ-008.design_rationale: Section 2.3 specifies PracticeEngine.onBeatTimeout(), PianoAudioSynthesizer.playMetronomeClick(isDownbeat) generating a 25ms decaying transient (1200 Hz downbeat / 850 Hz beat), and the tempoJob beat-window coroutine clock in PracticeViewModel.
REQ-008.tasks_rationale: Task 3 defines unit tests in PracticeEngineTest.kt and PianoAudioSynthesizerTest.kt for onBeatTimeout(), metronome toggle state, and generateMetronomeClickSamples(), plus implementation across PracticeEngine.kt, PianoAudioSynthesizer.kt, and PracticeViewModel.kt.
REQ-008.debate_rationale: ADR-008 addresses acoustic bleed risks by synthesizing a brief 25ms transient below the 80ms+ pitch detection lock window of YIN/SPICE, and rejects stopping/restarting AudioRecord every beat to avoid hardware audio glitches.
REQ-008.evidence_rationale: verification.md Sections 2-4 confirm PracticeEngineTest (testOnBeatTimeoutInTempoMode) and PianoAudioSynthesizerTest (testMetronomeClickSampleCount, testMetronomeClickAmplitudeAndDecay) passed with exit code 0.

REQ-009.design_rationale: Section 2.4 defines SongProgressRepository (SongMastery model, 0..3 star thresholds, SharedPreferences persistence with in-memory test support), CustomSongRepository (importMidiStream via MidiFileParser.parse, difficulty inference, disk persistence), and UI integration in SongSelectionScreen, PracticeScreen, and MainActivity.
REQ-009.tasks_rationale: Task 4 defines unit tests in SongProgressRepositoryTest.kt and CustomSongRepositoryTest.kt for star thresholds, best-score retention, and MIDI import persistence, followed by repository and UI implementation.
REQ-009.debate_rationale: ADR-009 justifies JSON/SharedPreferences persistence with injectable test storage for repertoire scale (~30-200 melodies, <2ms latency) and rejects Room SQLite + KSP plugins to avoid unnecessary build complexity.
